name: MCAR9
tagline: AMD Ryzen AI 300 desktop PC with USB4 and OCuLink
description: MCAR9 provides AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 360, Ryzen AI 9 365 or Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor options, Radeon 880M/890M graphics, up to 128GB DDR5, dual 2.5GbE and dual NVMe storage. USB4 and OCuLink support high-speed peripherals and compatible external graphics docks.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 360 / Ryzen AI 9 365 / Ryzen AI 9 HX 370

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: 1 x HDMI (8k@60Hz/4K@120Hz); 1 x DP (8k@60Hz/4K@160Hz); 1 x USB4 (4K@120Hz)

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: 2 x DDR5 SO-DIMM Memory slot, Up to 128GB 5600MHz

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 2 x M.2 2280 NVME SSD hard drive slot

specifications.label: Front I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x power button; 1 x RST reset hole; 2 x USB 3.0; 1 x 3.5mm Combined audio interface; 1 x USB4 40Gbps; 1 x OCulink Connect to graphics card expansion dock

specifications.label: Rear I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x DC IN 19V/6.32A; 2 x Intel i226V 2.5G Ethernet LAN; 1 x HDMI 2.1; 1 x DP 2.1; 1 x USB3.0; 1 x USB2.0
